title: Activity Diagram — Book Appointment
preconditions: 2. Selected ServiceOffering and facility/branch context are valid/active.
3. A published AvailabilityRelease exists for the selected service/day.
4. Patient has no prohibited overlapping active hold/confirmed Appointment.

nodes.label: Start
Patient selects service / doctor context and day
Conflicting overlapping ACTIVE ReservationHold or CONFIRMED Appointment exists?
Reject conflicting new booking attempt; preserve existing booking/hold
Find earliest currently bookable ArrivalGroup
Currently bookable ArrivalGroup available?
Offer Notify Me When Available; create no hold
Display arrival window and governing snapshotted terms
Patient confirms intent to proceed
Atomically acquire one ACTIVE ReservationHold and start countdown
Hold acquisition succeeded?
Report capacity full / temporarily held; create no Appointment
Governing booking policy?
Patient completes final booking information and accepts payment due at facility
Revalidate hold, release, group and time eligibility
Hold / target still eligible?
Expire or release hold; create no Appointment
Atomically consume hold and create one CONFIRMED Appointment
Display booking confirmation and payment due at facility
Run Process Full Payment activity for full snapshotted amount
Trusted full-payment result supports confirmation while target remains eligible?
Do not create conflicting Appointment; follow payment recovery/refund/UNDER_REVIEW rules
Atomically consume hold and create one CONFIRMED Appointment with booking snapshot
Display confirmed Appointment and paid payment state separately
End-path merge
End

edges.meaning: Payment recovery branch ends/continues outside booking

binding_business_rules: Patient does not choose arbitrary ArrivalGroup; system uses earliest currently bookable group.
One booking action protects/consumes one capacity unit.
FULL_PAYMENT_REQUIRED confirms only from trusted payment success while booking target remains valid.
Arrival window is not an exact doctor-entry time.
explicitly_forbidden: Duplicate Appointment or hold on retry.
qa_gates: 1. Verify the exact Use Case title and scope.
2. Verify the Initial Node exists and has no incoming flow.
3. Verify the Activity Final exists and has no outgoing flow.
4. Verify every Action is source-supported and verb-led.
5. Verify every Decision has meaningful guarded outgoing flows.
6. Verify every Merge is used only to reunite alternatives, not as decoration.
7. Verify Fork/Join is absent unless true parallelism is explicitly required.
8. Verify all arrows are Control Flows unless an Object Flow is explicitly specified.
10. Verify no Sequence lifeline/message notation appears.
11. Verify actor permissions and product boundaries.
12. Verify independent lifecycle states are not collapsed into one generic status.
13. Verify all rendered branch guards are mutually understandable and not contradictory.
14. Render SVG/PNG/PDF; open every actual output and inspect it visually.
15. Compare the render against this MD item-by-item and correct semantic, notation, routing, and readability issues.
